note: PLACEHOLDER DATA FOR UI DEVELOPMENT ONLY. All numerical values are synthetic and invented with a fixed random seed. They MUST be replaced by the output of the pipeline scripts (pipeline/01-05) before any public use. These are NOT survey results and are NOT claimed to represent real households, districts, or any outcome of the EICV7 data.
rule_A_note: Rule A has exactly 1 record per area, at that area's observed actual_coverage; its budget_share equals actual_coverage. poor_reached / extreme_poor_reached are SHARES in [0,1] of the poor population, not counts.
share_scale_note: poor_reached, poor_reached_ci, and extreme_poor_reached are fractions of the total poor (resp. extreme-poor) households in the area, i.e. 0 = 0 % and 1 = 100 %.
